description: Tell the Crook tab Codex runs in what it is doing: running when a prompt is sent and around every tool, needs-input naming the tool whenever it stops for an approval, idle when its turn ends, and the pull request a `gh pr create` opened. Each command does nothing unless it runs in a Crook pane or inside tmux, with the crook binary reachable ($CROOK_BIN, else crook on PATH); inside tmux, crook writes the report to the terminal of each of tmux's clients, and one that is not Crook drops it unread. Each exits 0 even when the report fails. Codex runs none of them until you trust them, and asks again whenever a command here changes.

hooks.command: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent running --title - || exit 0
[ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent running || exit 0

[ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent running --pull-request - || exit 0

[ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent needs-input --message - || exit 0
[ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent idle || exit 0
[ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent idle || exit 0
